# Payroll Vault Frederick

> Locally owned payroll, payroll tax and HR services for small businesses in Frederick, Maryland and across Frederick County. No contracts. A real person answers, Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm.

## Facts

- Business: Payroll Vault Frederick. Each Payroll Vault location is independently owned and operated.
- Owners: Mike and Lisa Taylor, a husband and wife who live in Frederick. Mike runs the location.
- Opened: January 1, 2025.
- Mike Taylor: US Army, 1989 to 1993. About 30 years in insurance and risk management before payroll.
- Team: Mike and four payroll processors.
- Service area: Frederick and all of Frederick County, Maryland, including Frederick, Urbana, Walkersville, Middletown, Brunswick, Thurmont, Mount Airy, New Market, Myersville, Emmitsburg, Ijamsville and Adamstown. Service-area business with no walk-in office.
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm.
- Phone (call or text): 301.479.0433
- Email: Mike.Taylor@payrollvault.com
- Client login (employer and employee portal): https://www.payrollvault.com/employer-employee-portal-login.html
- Memberships: Frederick County Chamber of Commerce; BNI.
- Contracts: none.

## Services

- Full-service payroll processing: every run, every pay stub, every deposit.
- State and local payroll tax: federal, Maryland and Frederick County.
- HR support and compliance.
- Time and attendance.
- Employee self-service portal: pay stubs and W-2s online.
- Workers' compensation administration with pay-as-you-go quotes.
- Maryland labor law compliance, including labor law posters.
- Background checks and drug screening.
- 401(k) through Payroll Vault's partnership with 401GO.

## Who we work with

Small and mid-sized businesses in Frederick County, and the CPAs, bookkeepers and business advisers who refer them.
